notes.JE-4_is_correct: JE-4 debits Expenses:COGS:Tariff 13,132.00 and credits Assets:Inventory:Parts 13,132.00. That is right because of two earlier events. (1) The 2025-09-30 accrual booked the whole expected refund as a credit to Expenses:COGS:Tariff, so no refund sat in inventory at that point. (2) On 2025-10-01, at POL-001 1.1 adoption, the controller moved the duty on parts then on hand (57,972.00) out of Expenses:COGS:Tariff and into Assets:Inventory:Parts. So by the refund date the duty attributable to parts still on hand lives in inventory: the 13,132.00 on-hand portion of the refund must reduce Assets:Inventory:Parts, while only the 768.00 on parts already sold belongs in COGS.
notes.duty_per_unit: duty_per_unit on inventory_layers = CBP 7501 duty for all programs on the entry / qty_received: boards 90.00, frames 210.00, burrs 12.00.
notes.broker_removed: Brewline pays CBP directly. There is no customs broker, no broker fee and no broker overbilling, so the only planted mistake is PM-1: Section 232 duty in the refund forecast. Duties paid per the books equal the 7501 total, 59,790.00.
notes.JE_renumbering: The old JE-2 was the broker claim and is gone. JE-3..JE-6 became JE-2..JE-5; each entry carries its former id in `was` so older notes can still be followed.
